page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9ae.48xlarge is a high-density, compute-optimized instance designed for large-scale parallel processing. The server is built on the x86_64 architecture and utilizes dedicated AMD EPYC 9T95 processors running at a base frequency of 2.25 GHz across 192 vCPUs. Memory is configured at 384.0 GB, resulting in an exact 2.0 GB per vCPU ratio typical of compute-focused platforms. Virtualization is supplied via a KVM hypervisor.

Network connectivity features a high-throughput baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps to support significant inter-node communication. The instance does not include local disk storage, meaning persistent data and operating system installations rely entirely on network-attached block volumes. Similarly, there are no discrete graphics processors or hardware accelerators included on this instance configuration.

By delivering massive dedicated thread density with a tightly controlled memory footprint, the configuration provides qualitative cost efficiency for compute-bound tasks that do not justify the price of high memory allocations. Hardware trade-offs center on the absence of bundled local storage and moderate memory capacity per core. The ecs.c9ae.48xlarge is well matched for distributed batch computation, multi-threaded code compilation, video transcoding, and high-concurrency web serving workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9ae.48xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture using dedicated AMD EPYC 9T95 processors. Operating at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz, the system provides 192 dedicated vCPUs paired with 384.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 2.0 GB per core ratio aligned with compute-focused computing requirements. The server operates under a KVM hypervisor and delivers a baseline network throughput of 100 Gbps for high-volume network communications. There are no onboard local storage drives and zero discrete GPU accelerators included, requiring the integration of network-attached block volumes for system and runtime storage. By allocating substantial parallel compute resources without excessive memory overhead, this hardware configuration offers cost-efficient processing power for compute-bound architectures. The ecs.c9ae.48xlarge is suited for distributed data processing, continuous integration compilation clusters, video encoding, parallel scientific simulations, and scalable web tier serving.
